# Third-party material

`optimization.py` (bisection-based wireless-power-transfer and time-allocation optimizer) and `data/data_10.mat`
(channel gains of ten wireless devices) are taken from the DROO project:

L. Huang, S. Bi and Y.-J. A. Zhang, "Deep reinforcement learning for online computation offloading in wireless
powered mobile-edge computing networks," IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing 19(11), 2581-2593 (2020).

They are redistributed under the MIT License of that project, reproduced in `DROO_LICENSE`.
